reading.body:
Digital Realty's EWR20 facility in Clifton sits within the operator's tri-site New Jersey metro campus near Newark airport. The operator has not published the critical IT megawatt capacity for this building specifically, making it impossible to estimate its contribution to AI infrastructure in the state. This absence of data is the binding constraint on assessing its role.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities, of which only 5 publish power figures totaling 111.3 MW. EWR20's ranking at sixth by published capacity means either it has no published figure and is ranked by inferred or historical data, or the ranking reflects a subset of disclosed capacity. The operator's choice not to publish per-building power for this facility leaves its scale relative to the state's disclosed capacity unknown.

Without a megawatt figure from the operator, EWR20 cannot be weighed against the state's other facilities or against the grid's stated constraints. The facility exists and is addressable. Whether it matters to AI scaling depends on data the operator has chosen not to disclose.
